utility.notes: FPL is the well-established dominant electric utility for Brevard County (the Space Coast area).

value.name: Florida Power & Light (FPL)
value.notes: No Community Choice Aggregator was found serving Brevard County's residential solar customers this session; FPL is recorded as both the distribution and default generation utility.

city.notes: This record covers unincorporated Brevard County. Incorporated cities within the county (e.g., Melbourne, Palm Bay, Titusville) that operate their own building departments would be separate AHJs not covered by this record.

permit_authority.notes: The Florida Building Code (FBC) is a genuinely mandatory, uniform statewide code (uniquely rigorous due to hurricane/wind-load requirements), but enforcement is local. Brevard County's own Planning & Development Department is the AHJ for unincorporated county areas, using its own online portal, Brevard's Advanced Service Site (BASS).

interconnection_url.notes: See the identical FPL net-metering notes on the Miami-Dade County, FL record (fl-miamidade-miamidadecounty-fpl) — true retail-rate net metering, excess generation deducted from the monthly bill or credited forward within the same calendar year.

required_documents.notes: Per the County's own page. Owner/Builders must personally appear to submit their application in accordance with Florida Statute Section 489.103. Licensed professional categories that may pull this permit: Building, Electrical, General, Residential, Residential Electrical, and Solar Contractor.

value: Registered contractors can schedule inspections online 24/7 through Brevard's Advanced Service Site (BASS)
